jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS OpenSearch
jobs.description: Amazon OpenSearch Service is a fully managed service that makes it easy to deploy, operate, and scale OpenSearch clusters for log analytics, full-text search, application monitoring, and more. As part of AWS, we serve hundreds of thousands of customers who rely on OpenSearch to power mission-critical search and observability workloads at scale. As a Software Development Engineer on the OpenSearch team, you will help solve a variety of technical challenges in distributed systems, data ingestion, and search infrastructure. You will play an active role in translating business and functional requirements into concrete deliverables and build quick prototypes or proofs of concept in partnership with other technology leaders within the team. You will help invent new features, design, develop, and deploy reliable distributed services that operate at massive scale across all AWS regions. You will work with a variety of core languages and technologies including Rust, Java, Python, Golang and AWS-native services. You will tackle challenging problems in areas such as cluster management, data pipeline orchestration, query optimization, and multi-tenant infrastructure — all while ensuring high availability and security for our customers. You should be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity that's higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving problems that span the full stack — from control plane APIs to data plane performance. Along the way, we guarantee that you'll learn a ton, have fun, and make a positive impact on many customers. Join a newly formed, high-performing, AI-led team driving a greenfield Think Big initiative to define the next generation of search and AI infrastructure. Key job responsibilities * Design, develop and support high throughput, highly available, distributed, multi-tenant, cloud native systems. * Produce bullet-proof code that is robust, efficient and maintainable; our primary languages are Java and Rust. * Leading development and maintenance of key system features for Amazon OpenSearch Service * Designing and building scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems * Work on challenging problems in areas such as data ingestion, auto-scaling, data storage, search optimization and query optimization, security, machine learning and more. * Identify and advocate for operational improvements, reducing maintenance and development cost * Join a great group of motivated, top-notch, people and work with them to solve challenging problems in a fun, collaborative environment Internal job description Basic qualifications * Working with other team members to investigate design approaches, prototype solutions, and validate them through testing * Working in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver high quality software in a fast paced environment. 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language Preferred qualifications 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent About the team ABOUT AWS: Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. The Off-Search team within Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) builds delightful ad experiences across surfaces beyond Search — product detail pages, the homepage, and store-in-store pages. We deliver highly personalized, context-aware advertising that adapts to individual shopper preferences, scales across diverse page types, and integrates seamlessly with organic recommendations. We operate full stack — from backend ads-retail edge services, ad retrieval, and ad auctions to shopper-facing experiences — all designed to deliver meaningful value. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS CloudWatch OpenTelemetry
jobs.description: AWS CloudWatch OpenTelemetry is hiring! Come build the next generation of cloud observability with us. Amazon CloudWatch gives every AWS customer a single platform to send, store, and query metrics from over 70 AWS services alongside their own application telemetry, using the OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) and Prometheus Query Language (PromQL). Our Seattle team owns the query execution and long-term metrics storage systems that make this possible: the distributed query engine that evaluates PromQL expressions in real time, the storage access layer that serves reads across storage tiers, and the durable pipeline that compacts and indexes billions metric data points per day and keeps them queryable for up to 15 months. We serve customers who depend on CloudWatch to monitor production systems using Grafana, Prometheus, and other Prometheus-compatible tools. The Seattle team is small, early, and still making the foundational architecture decisions that will shape this service for years. Engineers who join now will have a visible and lasting influence on what it becomes. Engineers who thrive here pair strong distributed systems instincts with the discipline to build for correctness and availability at AWS scale. Key job responsibilities - Design, implement, and test new features across our distributed query and long-term metrics storage systems using Rust and Java, leveraging AWS services including S3, Kinesis, DynamoDB, and ECS. - Operate and maintain a globally available 24x7 service that customers rely on to monitor, alert, and analyze their metrics in real time, identifying root causes of operational issues and applying permanent fixes. - Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand requirements, influence our roadmap, and shape how millions of developers and SREs monitor their systems. - Contribute to the full software development lifecycle — from design and code reviews to testing, deployment, and documentation — while mentoring teammates through constructive feedback. - Evaluate new tools and approaches to keep our systems and practices current, making recommendations to the team on adoption and integration. A day in the life On a typical day you might root-cause a customer query issue, release a new feature, consult with principal engineers on a hard architectural tradeoff, or design a solution to a storage or performance challenge you have never seen before. You translate customer requirements into designs, evaluate tradeoffs, and break work into incremental deliverables your team can ship. A strong community of principal and senior engineers gives direct feedback and pushes your thinking. You are surrounded by people who are passionate about observability and who believe there is still a lot of ground to cover in helping developers, SREs, and operators understand their systems. About the team The AWS CloudWatch OpenTelemetry team builds the query execution and long-term metrics storage systems behind Amazon CloudWatch. We are a small, early-stage team in Seattle making foundational architecture decisions that will shape this service for years. Our mission is to give every AWS customer a reliable, performant way to store, query, and act on their metrics using open standards like OTLP and PromQL. We invest in growing our engineers from day one — you will be paired with a buddy, work closely with senior and principal engineers, and build a personalized development plan with your manager. Our culture values knowledge sharing, constructive feedback, and an inclusive environment where every voice is heard. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - Experience with server, storage, networking, or large-scale distributed systems - Experience leading the design, build and deployment of complex and performant (reliable and scalable) software solutions in production - Familiarity with time-series data, metrics systems, or the Prometheus and OpenTelemetry ecosystems - Experience with S3-based storage, stream processing (e.g., Kinesis, Kafka), or columnar storage formats such as Parquet - Familiarity with PromQL or other query languages for time-series data - Experience with query planning, storage compaction, or performance optimization at scale Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.description: Amazon Leo is an initiative within Amazon that aims to revolutionize global connectivity through the development of a state-of-the-art Low Earth Orbit (LEO) interconnected satellite communication constellation. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide by delivering high-speed, low-latency internet services to underserved and unserved communities around the world. By leveraging satellite technology, we are working towards a future where everyone has access to reliable and high-quality internet connectivity regardless of their location. The Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering organization is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted government and international customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. ALG Engineering leads the development and delivery of targeted and scalable solutions for custom space and terrestrial applications. ALG collaborates closely with Project LEO to leverage the constellation of advanced satellites to provide seamless and efficient communication capabilities to meet the needs of our customers. The ALG Engineering team is seeking highly technical and talented individuals who are passionate about creating unique solutions that result in a positive impact on a global scale. About the Role We're looking for a Network Development Engineer to help build and maintain network infrastructure across data center and engineering environments. You'll contribute to architectures that support production systems, integration environments, and engineering labs — learning to deliver reliability and scalability while supporting teams in moving fast. You'll apply data center networking fundamentals — switching, routing, segmentation, and basic automation — across environments with varying requirements. You'll work alongside senior engineers to implement designs, troubleshoot issues, and build foundational automation that keeps infrastructure running smoothly. About You You're eager to learn and build. You have solid networking fundamentals and are developing your skills in automation and infrastructure-as-code. You're comfortable configuring switches and routers, and you're building the instinct to ask "how do I automate this?" You're not afraid to dig into a packet capture or trace a connectivity issue end-to-end, and you understand that reliable infrastructure is what enables great engineering. contribute to tooling that enables infrastructure to scale Support & sustain multi-tenant network environments including technology refresh, patching, and day-to-day operations — following established processes for simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions Troubleshoot & resolve network issues spanning physical layer through application connectivity; escalate complex cross-domain events while learning root-cause analysis techniques Collaborate with hardware, systems, and software engineering teams to understand requirements and support smooth rollout of new designs and products Contribute to network deployment projects, sustaining engineering tasks, and infrastructure scaling efforts under the direction of senior engineers Follow and maintain standards for change management, documentation (SOPs, implementation guides, knowledge transfer), and configuration control Basic Qualifications 1+ years of major internet routing protocols experience 1+ years of working in a Linux/Unix environment experience 1+ years of data center, critical environment, network deployment, or data center operations experience, or experience with Network Protocols: TCP/IP, Ethernet, L2/L3 technologies 1+ years of network engineering experience (design, deployment, or operations) Experience with enterprise/data center switching platforms (Arista, Cisco Nexus, Juniper, or similar) Familiarity with at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or similar) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field Preferred Qualifications Experience with network automation tools (Ansible, Netmiko, NAPALM, or similar) Experience with Linux networking (bridges, namespaces, virtual interfaces, firewalling) Exposure to infrastructure-as-code concepts (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar) Experience supporting engineering labs, test environments, or integration infrastructure Familiarity with version control systems (Git) Interest in or exposure to SDN concepts, programmable data planes, or SONiC Interest in or exposure to RF, satellite, or communications system hardware integration Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.
